summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K reporting share buy-backs under a program announced February 4, 2026, running from February 13, 2026 to January 15, 2027. The program has a total purchase amount of NOK 1,971,000,000 for up to 19,600,000 shares, split into two tranches. On April 15, 2026, Equinor purchased 444,297 shares at an average price of NOK 357.8681 per share. Following these transactions, Equinor holds 64,867,299 own shares, representing 2.54% of share capital. The buy-back is for employee share programs and potential capital reduction. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is applicable. Watch for buy-back pace and any subsequent capital reduction announcements.
